title: Has Nigerian Afrobeats overtaken Congolese rumba?
text: August 9, 2013 - I would not say that Nigerian music is taking over from the monopoly of Congolese music. Nigerian music is more about the club bangers – party music – but Congolese music is the original African rumba. It will be listened to by people who want to listen to it, whereas the current Nigerian beats is more something you would just come across.
